name: portal-relay
description: Deploy, operate, and diagnose a self-hosted Portal relay, on any Linux host or through Oracle Cloud, Hetzner Cloud, AWS, and Cloudflare DNS.

interface.longDescription: Deploy a public Portal relay with Docker Compose, delegate its DNS zone to the embedded authoritative DNS server, optionally enable TCP/UDP lease ports for game hosting, verify health and tunnel egress, register the relay in the public pool, administer lease approval and limits, and diagnose relay failures layer by layer.
defaultPrompt: Run a public Portal relay on this server and verify its health endpoint.
Set up a Portal relay with TCP/UDP leases for game hosting.
Register my Portal relay in the public relay pool.
Deploy a Portal relay on Oracle Cloud and configure DNS with Cloudflare.
Approve the pending tunnels on my Portal relay.
Find out why my Portal relay is not reachable.
